warnings: No draft rules were created. The captured text is M.G.L. c.186 §18, an anti-reprisal and retaliation provision. It makes landlords liable for damages for retaliating against tenants who report violations or join tenants' unions. It also creates a rebuttable presumption of reprisal when a termination notice, rent increase, or substantial change in tenancy terms follows within six months, and it voids waivers in leases. This does not fit any of the six supplied categories: rent_increase_limits, just_cause_eviction, security_deposits, application_screening_fees, screening_restrictions, algorithmic_rent_setting. It does not cap rent increases and does not require just cause for eviction, so it was not forced into a category.
